subject: Mobile Development
title: Android: The Open Alternative
description: A 60-second lesson on Android: The Open Alternative.

hook.text: Google bought a tiny startup called Android in 2005 for just $50 million.

buildup.text: Andy Rubin's team was building an open-source operating system for smart cameras.

discovery.text: Google pivoted Android to phones and gave it away free to any manufacturer.

twist.text: The first Android phone, the HTC Dream, looked clunky compared to the iPhone.

climax.text: Free and open won. Android now runs on over 70% of smartphones worldwide.

punchline.text: A $50 million bet now powers most phones.

quiz.question: How much did Google pay for Android?
